summary: [¶] Petition under Section 79(1)(f) for adjudication of dispute on change of time stamping and the documentation required as proof of lease rights for grant of connectivity under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Connectivity and General Network Access to the inter- State Transmission System) Regulations, 2022. [¶] Shri Anand K. Ganeshan, Advocate, ISPL Ms. Swapna Seshadri, Advocate, ISPL Shri Harsha V Rao, Advocate, ISPL Ms. Aishwarya Subramani, Advocate, ISPL Shri Ranjeet Singh Rajput, CTUIL Shri Lashit Sharma, CTUIL [¶] The Petitioner, Indosol Solar Private Limited, has filed the present Petition seeking adjudication of dispute on the documentation required as proof of lease rights for the grant of connectivity under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Connectivity and General Network Access to the inter-State Transmission System) Regulations, 2022 (hereinafter referred to as the “GNA Regulations”). The Petitioner has made the following prayers: [para 2] 2. Subsequently, the Petitioner filed Interlocutory Application (IA) No. 98 of 2023 with the following prayers: [para 3] 3. IA No.98 of 2023 was heard on 29.11.2023. During the course of the hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioner and the representative of the Respondent, CTUIL, made elaborate submissions on the IA and considering their respective submissions, the Commission directed the Respondent, CTUIL, to dispose of the application of the Petitioner within ten days in accordance with law. The Petitioner was also granted liberty to mention the main Petition or the IA only after the disposal of its application by the CTUIL. [para 4] 4. During the course of the proceedings on 31.7.2025, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that their grievance raised in the present case no longer survives, and the Petition may, accordingly, be disposed of as having been rendered infructuous. [para 5] 5. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that the prayers made in this Petition no longer survive for our consideration, the Petition is, accordingly, disposed of as having been rendered infructuous. [para 6] 6. Petition No. 373/MP/2023, along with pending IA, is disposed of in terms of the above.
title: Petition under Section 79(1)(f) for adjudication of dispute on change of time stamping and the documentation required as proof of lease rights for grant of connectivity under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Connectivity and General Network Access to the inter- State Transmission System) Regulations, 2022. Indosol Solar Private Limited
